# Lab 13.1: Set Up BigQuery AI

## What We Are Going to Do
Set up both ways to call Gemini from BigQuery: your own credentials (no connection), and a Cloud resource connection with a service account. Then test each one.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Enable Vertex AI and give yourself access.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud services enable aiplatform.googleapis.com
bq --location=US mk --dataset $PROJECT_ID:lab13
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT_ID \
  --member="user:$(gcloud config get-value account)" --role=roles/aiplatform.user --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Test with end-user credentials.** No connection is given, so BigQuery uses your own identity:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT AI.GENERATE('In one sentence, what is BigQuery?').result AS answer;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[CLI] Make sure the connection can call Vertex AI.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SA=$(bq show --format=json --connection $PROJECT_ID.us.lab_conn | python3 -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)['cloudResource']['serviceAccountId'])")
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT_ID --member=serviceAccount:$SA --role=roles/aiplatform.user --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[SQL] Test with the connection.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT AI.GENERATE('In one sentence, what is a data warehouse?',
                   connection_id =&gt; 'us.lab_conn',
                   endpoint =&gt; 'gemini-3.5-flash').result AS answer;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[Console] Understand the region.** Your query runs in `US`, so the short endpoint `gemini-3.5-flash` resolves to the **us** endpoint. Queries in an EU region use the **eu** endpoint; other regions use **global**.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| End-user credentials | Quick for analysts, uses your IAM role |
| Connection | Stable service account, best for schedules and pipelines |
| Role needed | `roles/aiplatform.user` |
| Endpoint | Short model name picks the regional endpoint |
